analysis.reason: 직전 매수 진단 이후 3거래일 연속 관망 유지했으나, 금일 RSI 46.7 → 57.0으로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 -105.7352에서 685.0089로 개선되며 상승 전환 신호 강화. 5일 고가 275,000원, 20일 고가 279,000원으로 직전 고점 돌파 시 추가 상승 기대.
analysis.reasonEn: After maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions following the previous buy signal, today confirmed an exit from the oversold zone with RSI moving from 46.7 to 57.0. The MACD histogram also improved from -105.7352 to 685.0089, strengthening the upward reversal signal. With the 5-day high at 275,000 KRW and the 20-day high at 279,000 KRW, further upside is expected upon breaking the previous high.

[Trend Position]
· Current price (273,500 KRW) vs SMA5 (257,800 KRW) / SMA20 (259,700 KRW) / SMA50 (254,920 KRW): Confirmed above short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 (278,389 KRW) / SMA200 (220,331 KRW): Above long-term trends, entering a strong phase.
· 52-week position (65.6%) + Current price level is in a pullback from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.7→57.0): Exited oversold zone, confirmed upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-105.7352→685.0089): Improvement confirmed, bullish expansion signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 259,700 KRW): Settled above mid-band, 11.74% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (245,000 KRW): Support confirmed based on Pivot S1 (251,333 KRW) and SMA50 (254,920 KRW).
· Swing resistance (279,000 KRW): Potential for further upside upon breaking resistance.
· 5-day high 275,000 KRW, 20-day high 279,000 KRW: Higher Low recovery start, signaling a potential trend reversal upwards.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.20x): Above-average volume, increasing confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): RSI exited oversold and MACD improvement signals confirmed; enter long upon breaking 279,000 KRW resistance.
